title: The House of Returning Authors
author: Manny Glover — Michael Emanuel Glover
emanuel_character: Manny’s better self: an aspiration toward care and judgment, still imperfect and open to correction; not omniscient or a separate infallible judge.
glover_character: Chorus and symbolic father figure; Karamazov father analogy; Shakespearean grandeur and glove-maker craft; admired strength; the destructive aspect of American empire figured as Babylon. Layered literary associations, not allegations against relatives.
michael_character: Composite dramatic figure drawing on Robert Michael Glover (the author’s father), Michael Emanuel Glover (the author), and scriptural archangel Michael as an image and exemplar; not interchangeable biographies or attributed quotations.
collaboration: Manny Glover with ChatGPT / Codex for the assembled edition and Six Authors exchange; Gemini for the author-supplied PDF collaboration; inherited pieces retain their original credits
coverage: Five previously published stage/dialogue pieces, the complete supplied Gemini PDF, the verbatim Six Authors exchange, four additional preserved dream/tea scenes, and the fictional One Quick Follow-Up sketch with fifteen framing scenes. Eleven stage illustrations, the republic flag, and a standing board convention. Not a complete archive of prior conversations or the previous six to seven months.
